front.title: OAuth 2.0 Token Exchange with Actor-Bound Tokens

abstract.t: In OAuth 2.0 Token Exchange, the client that sends the request receives the token, and with DPoP the token is bound to the key that signed the client's proof. Agent systems often need one party to obtain a token for another: an orchestrating agent that approves an action obtains a token for the agent that will perform it. This document lets a token exchange client request that the issued token be bound to the key of the actor named in the request, and requires the actor to prove possession of that key, so that the token is usable only by the actor and only with its consent.
